_notice: Written and frozen before running the detector registry against this set — no detector logic was modified after seeing these results. See docs/BENCHMARK_METHODOLOGY.md's holdout section and evaluation/holdout-result.json for the actual run.

holdout-01-library-registry.explanation: Registry.setExecutor has no access control; VaultRouter delegatecalls to whatever it currently returns. Multi-contract variant of the library-dependency pattern.

holdout-02-bridge-relayer.explanation: Bridge.release only accepts calls from the fixed relayer address; Relayer can be permanently disabled with no replacement or fallback path for funds already deposited.

holdout-03-pausable-vault.explanation: pause() exists with no corresponding unpause() anywhere; once paused, withdraw() is permanently unreachable. Bool-flag pattern, not FLARE's dev-fixture enum pattern.

holdout-04-unchecked-erc20-vault.explanation: transferFrom/transfer return values are never checked; a non-reverting-on-failure token desyncs internal accounting from actual balances.

holdout-05-staking-no-exit.explanation: No user-facing withdrawal function exists anywhere for the pool's primary staked asset; the only balance-reducing function burns funds rather than returning them.

holdout-06-immutable-wallet-library.explanation: Wallet's library target is immutable (cannot be repointed), but the library itself (Lib.sol) has an unprotected selfdestruct — the Parity mechanism's shape, reproduced originally across two contracts.

holdout-07-safe-vault-guarded.explanation: Paired safe control for holdout-03: correct unpause() plus an always-available emergencyWithdraw().

holdout-08-safe-bridge-with-timeout.explanation: Paired safe control for holdout-02: a timeout-based self-service claim removes the single-point-of-failure dependency on the relayer.

holdout-09-safe-erc20-vault.explanation: Paired safe control for holdout-04: every transfer's return value is checked and reverts on failure.

holdout-10-safe-staking-with-withdraw.explanation: Paired safe control for holdout-05: an ordinary staking contract where every staker can always withdraw their own principal.
